tests.name: real catalogue: six distinct guide photographs and three universes
canonical guide titles, summaries and publishers remain source data
original video IDs and thumbnails are used
content language is independent of UI language and reacts on render
language variant fr-FR belongs to French filter
expiry, disabled selections and future review are excluded
disabled shelf cannot expose active child picks
unresolved, mismatched and unqualified records are not fabricated
duplicate video identity appears once
titles, creators, reasons and evidence are escaped
unsafe thumbnail URLs are rejected; signed HTTPS is preserved
unsafe credit URLs and CSS positions cannot inject markup
unknown creator and estimated language are explicit
metadata and transcript review bases remain distinct
licensed photographs retain authors, source and license links
missing language selection yields honest empty state
three independent data sources degrade independently
total load failure leaves legacy fallback available
load is cached, render makes no requests, source data stays unchanged
destroy blocks pending load and clears markup

scope: Offline native module import, real catalogue fixture from read-only SQLite and local guides/photos, mocked fetch and host element. No browser, network, database mutation, layout measurement, rail interaction or production navigation test.
